challenges.title: Shift Operations, 3-Week Averaging and Art. 100

items.title: Shift Operations Beyond 8h/48h (Art. 100)
items.text: With ministry approval, employers running shift operations (العمل بنظام المناوبات) may exceed 8 hours per day or 48 hours per week — provided the average over 3 weeks comes back to 8h/48h.

items.title: Up to 9h/Day for Intermittent Duties
items.text: For staff categories with intermittent (non-continuous) duties, Art. 100 allows up to 9 hours per day — nearly impossible to track by hand across many wards and rotations.

items.title: Overtime Still under Art. 107
items.text: Even in shift operations, every overtime hour must be paid at the hourly wage plus 50% of the base wage (effectively 150%).

solutions.title: How Klacks Takes the Load Off Hospitals in Saudi Arabia
solutions.subtitle: From the 3-week average calculation to 24/7 coverage — it all fits together.

items.title: Gap-Free 24/7 Coverage
items.text: Day, evening and night shifts across all wards — Klacks flags every gap instantly and fills it automatically on request.

items.title: 3-Week Average Calculated under Art. 100
items.text: Klacks monitors the rolling 3-week average live and warns before the average of 8h/48h is exceeded — on request, Klacks hard-blocks the excess in automatic planning, with manual planning it stays at a warning.

items.title: 9-Hour Limit for Intermittent Duties
items.text: For categories with intermittent duties, a daily limit of up to 9 hours can be configured, and Klacks checks the schedule against it.

items.title: Overtime Premium as Time Credit
items.text: The statutory 50% premium on the base wage (Art. 107) can be stored as a time premium; Klacks credits it as time credit for every overtime hour, and your payroll system calculates the money amount.

items.title: Qualifications & Wards
items.text: Every shift is assigned only to appropriately qualified staff — per ward, department and role.

items.title: Installed on Your Premises: Data Stored on Your Servers
items.text: Klacks runs on your infrastructure. Staff and patient data are stored on your servers — with a locally hosted AI model, no AI request goes to an external AI provider.

items.title: Klacksy Understands Your Request
items.text: "Fill next week’s ER night shifts" is enough — Klacksy starts the planning, Klacks takes qualifications and the 3-week average into account.

example.title: Shift Rotation and 3-Week Averaging, One Plan
example.text: Klacks schedules shifts and gives early warning when the 3-week average is at risk of deviating from 8 hours per day or 48 hours per week (Art. 100), and credits every overtime hour with the configured statutory premium (Art. 107) as time credit.
